# StateEvent()

> **StateEvent**&lt;`Id` *extends* `string`&gt;(`spec`: [`EventSpec`](../interfaces/EventSpec.md)&lt;[`StateScope`](../interfaces/StateScope.md)&gt; & `object`): [`EventDefinition`](../interfaces/EventDefinition.md)&lt;`"state"`, `Id`&gt;

Defined in: [src/sdk/index.ts:250](https://github.com/maxmixalex/krieg-lang/blob/main/src/sdk/index.ts#L250)

Declare an event received by a state. Its callbacks operate in state scope, and its handle can be passed to a state scope's `schedule` method.
